summary: Package Debian ovmf-generic 2026.05-2 from an isolated signed sid source with its matching edk2 source, checksum manifest and offline Microsoft 2023 certificate-template screen; verify parsed installed EFI db certificates by exact fingerprint and validity; add python3-virt-firmware as an installed Core dependency. API impact: none.

guide.reason: The installer has no changed operator step; this is a packaged firmware and dependency correction.

api.reason: API impact: none. This changes ISO package contents only; no Controller/Core or client API request, response, authorization or state flow changes.

roadmap.reason: Exact-tree ISO evidence now passed, but the existing external-release gate remains open pending complete source-delivery and redistribution evidence.

state.reason: Build and package artifacts add no Nex durable runtime state.

verification.method: Inspected the ignored signed Debian sid retrieval evidence; reran the isolated sid APT download/source commands in the pinned ISO-builder container; extracted the exact package; then inspected exact-tree final development ISO SHA-256 403dc489fc8fb7d948fe3d27a561c4203a54642c27ac18141dae6ede4c84267c through static package/source inspection and disposable installation. Its parsed db fingerprint and checkend gate passed for Microsoft UEFI CA 2023 and Windows UEFI CA 2023; the final run emitted INSTALL_PASS, OVMF_2023_CERTIFICATES_PASS, ROOT_ONLY_PASS, FIRST_BOOT_PASS and REBOOT_PASS. External redistribution remains open.
